vi: bán hoặc đặt quá số chỗ thực có

gloss: to continue, especially despite difficulty
examples: If the error persists, please call the hotel directly.
viNote: Tiếp tục dù gặp khó, hoặc lỗi vẫn còn.

gloss: happening before something else
examples: Please send any changes prior to departure.
viNote: Prior to = trước khi.

gloss: a part of a whole, or the relationship between sizes
examples: A large proportion of her work is checking emails.

gloss: not wanting to do something
examples: The guest was reluctant to change hotels at the last minute.

gloss: closely connected to the subject
examples: Please include only the relevant times in the voucher.
vi: liên quan, sát với vấn đề

gloss: an extra amount of money you must pay
examples: A late check-out may include a small surcharge.

gloss: to keep something going over time
examples: Regular practice helps sustain her English.
vi: duy trì, giữ cho tiếp tục

gloss: complete and careful
examples: A thorough check of the names will prevent a problem at the airport.

gloss: to start a task and accept responsibility for it
examples: She will undertake the booking changes this afternoon.

gloss: almost, or done by computer rather than in person
examples: The job is virtually all done from home.
vi: hầu như; gần như hoàn toàn qua máy tính
viNote: Trong ví dụ: công việc gần như làm hết từ nhà.

gloss: happening or existing in many places
examples: Delays were widespread after the storm.
vi: lan rộng, xảy ra ở nhiều nơi

gloss: to give a share of something for a purpose
examples: The hotel will allocate a quiet room at the back.
vi: phân bổ, dành riêng một phần
viNote: Ví dụ: allocate a room = sắp một phòng cho ai.

gloss: the power or skill to do something
examples: The team has the capability to change a complex itinerary quickly.

gloss: clear, logical, and well organised
examples: The itinerary should tell one coherent story of the week.

gloss: to give money or something else for a loss or problem
examples: The airline will compensate the guest with a voucher.

gloss: short and clear, without wasted words
examples: Please keep the email concise and polite.

gloss: a limit on what you can do
examples: The only constraint is the early train the next morning.

gloss: to communicate an idea or a feeling
examples: A short, kind email can convey the change clearly.

gloss: the standards you use to judge something
examples: Price and quiet are the main criteria for this booking.
viNote: Số nhiều của criterion — các chuẩn để đánh giá.

gloss: the length of time something lasts
examples: The duration of the stay is four nights.
vi: thời lượng, khoảng thời gian kéo dài

gloss: something that is more important than other things
examples: A correct name on the ticket is the first priority.

gloss: to make something easier to understand
examples: I emailed the hotel to clarify the check-in time.

gloss: the final result of a process or a situation
examples: The outcome was a later flight and a complimentary seat.

gloss: the official or usual way of doing something
examples: The check-in procedure is explained on the voucher.
vi: thủ tục, quy trình chính thức

gloss: an amount of something reserved or given for a purpose
examples: The hotel is holding an allotment of ten rooms for the group.
vi: suất được giữ sẵn, hạn ngạch
viNote: Trong khách sạn: room allotment = số phòng giữ cho một đoàn hoặc một công ty.

gloss: the state of having more than one possible meaning
examples: The time in the email had some ambiguity, so I asked for confirmation.
vi: sự mơ hồ, chỗ có hơn một nghĩa

gloss: similar in a way that helps you compare two things
examples: A hotel allotment is analogous to a block of reserved seats on a train.
viNote: Giống nhau theo cách giúp so sánh hai việc.

gloss: based on chance or personal choice, not on a clear rule
examples: The extra fee seemed arbitrary, so she asked the hotel to explain it.
viNote: Dựa trên ý riêng hoặc ngẫu nhiên, không theo quy tắc rõ.

gloss: a strong statement that something is true
examples: His assertion that the room was prepaid was correct.

gloss: to collect information and put it together
examples: She will compile the vouchers into one file for the driver.

gloss: possible to imagine or believe
examples: It is conceivable that the train will be late after the storm.

gloss: to discuss something in order to decide, or to give an official title
examples: I need to confer with the hotel before I change the dates.
viNote: Thảo luận để đi đến quyết định.

gloss: to reach the highest or final point
examples: The trip will culminate in a family dinner in the village.
vi: kết thúc ở điểm cao nhất, lên đến đỉnh
viNote: Culminate in = kết lại bằng.

gloss: to delay something until a later time
examples: We should defer the booking until the new timetable is published.

gloss: to be a sign of something, or to mean something
examples: The red mark on the itinerary denotes a prepaid service.

gloss: to notice or recognise something that is not obvious
examples: It was hard to discern the correct terminal from the first email.
viNote: Thấy được điều không hiện ra rõ ngay.

gloss: a large difference, especially an unfair one
examples: There was a disparity between the price on the website and the invoice.

gloss: to spread information widely
examples: Please disseminate the new departure time to every guest in the group.

gloss: an area of knowledge, activity, or control
examples: Hotel reservations are her main domain at work.
viNote: Một khoảng chuyên môn, hoạt động hoặc quyền quản lý.

gloss: to get information or a reaction from someone
examples: A short question will elicit the check-in time from the hotel.
vi: khơi ra, moi được thông tin hoặc phản hồi

gloss: based on real experience and evidence, not only on theory
examples: We have empirical evidence that earlier transfers miss less traffic.
vi: dựa trên bằng chứng thực tế
viNote: Dựa vào kinh nghiệm và số liệu thật, không chỉ lý thuyết.

gloss: to be a typical example of something
examples: This quiet village stay exemplifies the kind of trip she loves.
vi: là ví dụ điển hình cho

gloss: complete, including everything
examples: The email was not an exhaustive list of every optional tour.

gloss: one side or aspect of something
examples: Pronunciation is only one facet of learning a word.

gloss: a strange habit or unusual feature of one person or thing
examples: One idiosyncrasy of this hotel is that check-in is only after three.

gloss: necessary as a duty, or describing the person who currently has a role
examples: It is incumbent on us to confirm the names before we issue tickets.
viNote: It is incumbent on us = chúng ta có trách nhiệm phải làm. Không phải người đang giữ chức ở đây.

gloss: existing as a natural part of something
examples: Some risk is inherent in a tight train connection.

gloss: necessary as a part of a whole
examples: A clear voucher is an integral part of the arrival plan.
vi: không thể thiếu, là phần thiết yếu

gloss: always, without changing
examples: The first email of the day is invariably about a time change.
vi: luôn luôn, không lần nào khác

gloss: an official order or authority to do something
examples: She does not have a mandate to offer a refund without approval.

gloss: so small that it is not worth considering
examples: The walk from the room to the beach is negligible.

gloss: a very small difference in meaning, feeling, or colour
examples: She is learning the nuance between reserved and booked.

gloss: a situation that seems impossible because it has two opposite sides
examples: It is a paradox that working from home can feel both quieter and busier.

gloss: more important than anything else
examples: Guest safety is paramount when we choose a transfer.

gloss: directly related to the matter being discussed
examples: The most pertinent detail is the real departure time, not the old one.
vi: sát vấn đề, liên quan trực tiếp

gloss: a large amount, more than you need
examples: The inbox had a plethora of similar questions about breakfast times.

gloss: something required before something else can happen
examples: A confirmed room is a prerequisite for issuing the voucher.

gloss: used when you think something is likely
examples: The driver is late, presumably because of the rain.

gloss: nearness in space or time
examples: The house is in close proximity to her parents home.
viNote: Gần về không gian hoặc thời gian.

gloss: to make two different ideas or facts fit together in a satisfactory way
examples: I need to reconcile the times on the voucher with the airline email.
vi: đối chiếu cho khớp, dung hòa
viNote: Làm cho hai thông tin hoặc hai ý khác nhau đi được với nhau.

gloss: belonging separately to each of the people or things just named
examples: Please send each guest to their respective hotels.

gloss: to look at something very carefully
examples: She will scrutinise the names on the ticket before she sends it.
viNote: Cách viết British; tiếng Mỹ viết scrutinize.

gloss: in a way that appears to be true, though it may not be
examples: A seemingly small typo can block a passenger at check-in.
viNote: Trông như đúng, nhưng chưa chắc đã đúng.

gloss: later, after something else
examples: The flight was cancelled and subsequently replaced with a later one.

gloss: to provide evidence that something is true
examples: The confirmation email will substantiate the prepaid stay.

gloss: understood without being said
examples: There was a tacit agreement that the driver would wait twenty minutes.

gloss: to support or form the basis of something
examples: Clear emails underpin a calm arrival for every guest.

gloss: polite behaviour, or a polite action given freely
examples: The fruit basket was a courtesy from the hotel, not part of the paid package.
vi: sự lịch sự; đãi ngộ tử tế
viNote: Một cử chỉ lịch sự được cho không, như giỏ trái cây của khách sạn.

gloss: a difference between two things that should be the same
examples: There was a discrepancy between the voucher and the hotel list.
viNote: Sự khác nhau giữa hai thứ lẽ ra phải giống nhau.

gloss: in spite of
examples: Notwithstanding the delay, the guests still reached the hotel for dinner.

gloss: the set of skills or pieces a person can perform or use
examples: She is adding work phrases to her English repertoire.
vi: vốn kỹ năng, vốn câu chữ có thể dùng

gloss: until now
examples: The hitherto quiet season has suddenly become busy.
vi: cho đến nay, trước tới giờ

gloss: relating to the quality of something, not only the amount
examples: We need qualitative comments from the guest, not only a score.
viNote: Nói về tính chất, không chỉ về số lượng.

gloss: by which, or according to which
examples: They use a simple system whereby every change is confirmed in writing.
viNote: A system whereby = một cách làm nhờ đó mà…
